name: Dual Marching Cubes with Ambiguity Resolution and Regularization
aliases: DMC with Ambiguity Resolution and Regularization
Dual Marching Cubes (DMC) with Ambiguity Resolution and Regularization
definition: A differentiable isosurface extraction method that computes dual vertices for grid cubes based on topology cases, resolving topological ambiguities (C16/C19) by checking adjacent cubes, and optionally optimizing vertex positions using a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) with gradient normals or linear interpolation with learned weights.
summary: Dual Marching Cubes with Ambiguity Resolution and Regularization extracts manifold isosurfaces by resolving topological ambiguities and optimizing vertex positions for improved surface fidelity.
